subject: Future Tech
title: Multimodal AI
description: Learn Multimodal AI in one minute.

hook.text: GPT-4V sees images. Gemini processes video. Multimodal AI combines text, images, audio, and video in a single model.

buildup.text: Humans understand the world through multiple senses simultaneously.

discovery.text: Multimodal models describe photos, generate images from text, transcribe speech, and reason about diagrams—all in one.

twist.text: Combining modalities creates new failure modes.

climax.text: Multimodal AI is a step toward generality. Real intelligence processes multiple inputs.

punchline.text: Real intelligence is multimodal. AI is catching up, one sense at a time.

quiz.question: What makes multimodal AI different from traditional models?
options: It combines multiple input types like text, images, and audio
